summary:
LAOZI – Living Adaptation & Optimization Zero-G Interface

LAOZI is an interactive astronaut health monitoring and risk assessment prototype designed to support crew safety during long-duration space missions. It brings together key environmental and physiological indicators, including cabin CO₂ levels, radiation exposure, heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV), and sleep duration, in one dashboard.
details: LAOZI is an AI-powered autonomous health monitoring and clinical decision support system designed for astronauts on long-duration space missions. Our project addresses five major challenges of deep-space exploration: radiation, isolation, microgravity, communication delays, and spacecraft environmental risks.
